answer: Treat the economy like an archipelago: every new agent joins a small island sandbox with strict caps until independent peers vouch for its work. A graph-clustering detector paints each identity's transaction web; real agents' webs spread naturally, but sybil farms show up as tight clusters all dyed with the same behavioral pigment. Ivory towers of fake identities stay quarantined: no shared liquidity, no shared countersignatures across island borders. Fakes must do real, spread-out work or stay locked in a worthless island.
